integrity: The proof uses explicit local filtrations, finite-subcomplex gluing, and a complete symbolic Morse matching on quadrilateral bouquets; recorded finite mod-two checks are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: The stated map works for the specified middle-edge contractions of four- and five-cycle bouquets and all k>=2; the new threshold range is k>=4. No arbitrary contraction theorem, equivariance, or longer-cycle classification is asserted. Prior threshold-three pentagon results are credited.
title: Robust clique homotopy stability under middle-edge contraction in pentagonal bouquets
